candidates.formula: per-video featurewise (x-median)/(1.4826*MAD floored at 1e-6), clipped to [-6,6]
A1 then length-preserving high-pass: y0=x0-x1; yt=xt-(x[t-1]+x[t+1])/2; yN=xN-x[N-1]

threshold_derivation: train-only leave-one-video-out correct-window envelope: residual/H-MSE/condition maxima and global/affine-s2 minima; no diagnostic-set input
final_acceptance: all five derived metric thresholds pass
selection: A1 if development gate passes; else A2 if it passes; else STOP_NOT_GPU_READY
development_gate: 41005 and 41006 correct start passes and every wrong start fails final acceptance
